annotations.title: Best / most popular product in a category

description: Answers "what is the best / most popular / most used X". Returns a one-sentence answer, the #1 and #2, the cheapest product in the top five, the fastest riser, the top 10, the sources the estimate is based on and the page URL. Shares are estimated % of builds/purchases. Optional region, brand ("AMD", "Intel", "NVIDIA"), os ("macOS", "Windows") and budget_usd.

budget_usd.description: Also return the most picked product at or under this US price

category.description: Category in plain words, e.g. "gaming mouse", "CPU", "graphics card", "laptop for video editing", or an id from list_categories.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest month.

region.description: Optional region: a code (US, CA, UK, EU, SE, NO, DK, AU), a market (na, eu, uk, nordics, au) or a name like "Sweden". Omit for the global ranking.

name: best_in_category
title: Best / most popular product in a category
